groups.p25_26: Native exclusive area UnitTypes 25 and 26, not 84 <= sqm < 85

observed: Whole-quarter invariant eligible sale contracts, includes cancellation/direct deals, excludes land leasehold; each contract one vote
stock: Supported native structural model prices at final completed Thursday; qualified within-complex area transfers retained; current measured exact-area households, known pre-construction stock excluded
quantile: Inverse weighted empirical CDF: smallest price with cumulative mass at least q of total; P90/P10 is not top-decile mean over bottom-decile mean
precision: Price/gap: 0.1 KRW hundred-million; ratios: 0.1; composition/known-stock coverage/transfer shares: whole percent. Each rounded independently.
support: At least 40 contracts or 100 households and 10 complexes; each <=P10 / >=P90 tail at least 10 mass and 10 complexes; stock maximum complex share 20%
limitations: Not household wealth inequality or same-home appreciation
Historical stock is current measured weights, not historical inventory
Unknown-area stock is outside coverage denominator
Full-history fixed stock fails tail support in every period; no fixed-path price values released
Unknown/future age remains in composition denominator but small category value is not shown
